target.role: bootstrap STRANGE GAIT opener that establishes bodily trust while making the crooked rhythmic grammar audible immediately
target.position: bootstrap opener — track 1 in empty ledger
target.purpose: establish Ground without spending Tilt or turning rhythmic complexity into spectacle

sourceWindows: Current and recent 2026 raw/deep/hypnotic techno releases with track-specific swing, lurch, syncopation, organic percussion or displaced-pulse evidence
Adjacent artist/label catalogues around Asymmetric, microtonal/polymetric techno, broken four-to-the-floor and mechanically human groove
Overlooked 2025–2026 catalogue previously incompatible with GROOVE OVER NOISE but freshly re-evidenced from official artist/label sources under the STRANGE GAIT constitution
Official Inigo Kennedy / Asymmetric Flux Rope release: https://inigokennedy.bandcamp.com/album/flux-rope
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: approximately 60 named tracks/releases across roughly 20 official artist, label, retailer and bounded-search result pages
exclusions: industrial or peak-time impact as the primary argument
hardgroove cliché or ornamental tribal percussion
IDM/glitch complexity whose main effect is technical display
straight functional techno with no evidenced gait deformation
tracks lacking enough exact identity/tempo/behaviour evidence to support the bootstrap opener gate
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Inigo Kennedy — Marauder: lurching four-to-the-floor, shuffled hats and bleep bass make crookedness bodily first
2. Sevish — Mystify: explicit 140 BPM polymetric techno with strong identity but higher complexity-as-spectacle risk
